Synopsis
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation follows Rudeus Greyrat, a former shut-in who is reborn into a fantasy world with his memories intact and determined to live a life without regret. Across volumes 1–26, Rudeus grows from a gifted but emotionally fragile child into a powerful mage as he faces dangerous monsters, political upheaval, and world-shaking magical disasters. His journey takes him across continents, where he forms deep bonds, reunites with lost companions, and confronts both external threats and the lingering traumas of his past life. As mysteries surrounding the Human-God, ancient powers, and the fate of the world unfold, Rudeus works to protect those he loves while striving to become a better man. The series blends adventure, character growth, romance, and complex worldbuilding into a long, evolving tale of redemption and self-discovery.
